## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits; it becomes the squash commit message.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm build` pass locally.
- [ ] The acceptance criteria of the linked issue are met.
- [ ] Docs are updated (`docs/features/`, `docs/architecture/` or a guide), or the change needs none.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` that ends with `#<this PR> @<your handle>`.
- [ ] Everything written in the repository and on GitHub is in English; site copy stays in Spanish.
